selection_policy: Frozen before any production duty run. No mid-campaign switching.

selections.rationale: Native JSONL envelope (session/agent_start/turn_start/message_*/turn_end/agent_end/agent_settled) is the highest-fidelity protocol offered by Pi and was used by LH-03's frozen adapter. RPC is bidirectional but unnecessary for bounded production duties.

ClineMM's --json flag emits a JSON event stream (agent_event envelope) with structured iteration_start/content_start/content_end/usage/tool/done events plus a final run_result block. This is the closest analogue to Pi's JSON_EVENTS and the path with the highest-fidelity tool/usage evidence.
selections.alternate_considered: ACP (not chosen; not part of LH-03 contract for this candidate)
